# Fabloom benchmark v0.1

<!-- Generated by `fabloom bench report`; do not edit by hand. -->

**How this was measured.** 49 scenarios x 2 arms, one run each, through the same run state machine the product uses. Each run is graded against the scenario's ground-truth intent: checks are compiled from that intent, never from model output, and evaluated by the `batfish-local` verifier. ## Arms

- `super-repair`: Super writes, Batfish verifies, Super repairs; never escalates. Up to 3 repair round(s), 1 candidate(s) per round, $0.25 run cap. Routing: explainer `nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning`, generator `nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL`, planner `nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning`, repairer `nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL`, repairer_escalated `nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL`.
- `routed`: The product's routing from conf/models.yaml, Ultra on repeated failure. Up to 3 repair round(s), 1 candidate(s) per round, $0.25 run cap. Routing: explainer `nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning`, generator `nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL`, planner `nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning`, repairer `nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL`, repairer_escalated `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b`.

## Definitions

- **First-pass**: the first generated candidate passed every compiled check, before any repair.
- **Final pass**: the run ended with a candidate passing every compiled check. The interval is a 95% Wilson score interval over scenarios; with tens of scenarios it is wide, and differences inside it are not evidence.
- **Unrecognised lines**: share of runs whose first candidate contained a line the parser did not recognise (the model invented a command), over runs whose first candidate reached a backend.
- **Pre-lint rejects**: share of runs whose first candidate the deterministic pre-lint rejected before any backend ran.
- **$/scenario**: mean model spend per run, from token counts and the prices in conf/models.yaml.
- **Wall**: run start to finish, nearest-rank percentiles.
